mentions.name: Music metadata aggregator
mentions.description: A music metadata aggregator that only incorporates metadata the builder can rely on: track credits, instruments (when available), lyrics, BPM/energy, and genre. It generates lists of similar tracks from a selected genre, artist, or song, and lets the user adjust the weights of era, instruments, and genre. Old-school NLP analysis of lyrics is planned as the next step. Not public yet and still very alpha.
mentions.problem: Existing machine learning approaches to music attributes like mood and Spotify valence are inconsistent, so nobody reliably knows how to aggregate trustworthy music metadata.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Just a personal project right now but it's a music metadata aggregator.

I find that nobody really knows how to do this. Machine learning can detect some song attributes well (bpm, ez right?) but it's inconsistent with some things (eg mood, spotify valence)
